    • interceptTestBody

      public static Object interceptTestBody(PytestMicronautExtension.Callable body, String testName) throws Throwable
      Runs a test body inside the TestMethodInterceptor chain of the extension serving the current test, so that the interceptors configured by MicronautTest actually wrap it.

      Without this the chain is never entered and everything delivered through it is inert -- transactional and rollback above all, which are accepted, turned into properties and then never acted on, so a row written by one test is still there in the next.

      Parameters:
      body - The test body
      testName - The pytest node id, used as the test name in the TestContext
      Returns:
      The value the body returned
      Throws:
      Throwable - Anything the body or an interceptor threw
